Scene: modest independent book designer's second-floor studio, afternoon after rain. Large wooden working table with four cream paper sample swatches, folded book dummies, pencil, ruler, proof sheets with abstract unreadable marks. Side shelves hold sample books, paper stock and files. Computer on far side of table, screen dark. Two simple chairs, a small glass of water and a desk lamp. Diffused daylight through a tall side window, potted greenery, lived-in work surfaces. Quiet intimate practical workspace, not luxury office. Clear floor in central foreground.
